name: registerRoute / getRouteMeta
summary: Register a route or read its metadata; declarative routes register on mount.

npm.registration: The npm root registers its custom elements automatically.

classic.registration: The script registers its custom elements automatically.

example.npm:
import { registerRoute, isRegisteredRoute, getRouteMeta } from '@beforesemicolon/router'

registerRoute('/about', { meta: { title: 'About' } })
console.log(getRouteMeta('/about'))
